_comment: The Player's Handbook version the rest of the repository has been synced to. assets/build_all.mjs compares this against the highest-numbered Starwrought_Players_Handbook_v*.docx and refuses to pass when they differ, because a handbook change is not finished until the spreadsheets, the web app, the Foundry system, its FEATURES.md and its CHANGELOG.md have all caught up.
